summary: WISeKey International Holding AG filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, furnishing a press release of its audited FY2025 financial results. The release reports FY2025 revenue of $19.3M (+62% YoY) and net loss of $38.2M; cash and short-term investments exceed $535M as of April 30, 2026. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action is communicated. The filing merely updates financial performance and reaffirms guidance.
